themes.title: Right-wing leaders seek re-election amid economic controversies
themes.blurb: Across multiple countries, right-wing leaders are positioning themselves for re-election despite facing significant economic challenges and public discontent. This theme highlights the parallel strategies and rhetoric used by these leaders to maintain power.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei confirms re-election bid in 2027, defending economic policies amid rising poverty and public discontent.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni becomes Italy's longest-serving post-war PM, facing criticism over economic policies and rising fuel costs.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump campaigns for re-election, focusing on economic policies and tariffs amid trade disputes.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS leaders explore reconciliation to regain power, amid internal divisions and economic challenges.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox positions itself for 2027 elections, leveraging anti-immigration rhetoric and regional power dynamics.

themes.title: Far-right parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying their anti-immigration rhetoric and policies, often in response to perceived border crises. This theme captures the shared framing of immigration as a national security and cultural threat.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox opposes redistribution of migrant minors from Ceuta, demanding their return to Morocco.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni and Salvini reject EU migrant redistribution plans, emphasizing national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt, pushing for stricter immigration controls and deportations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK intensifies anti-immigration rhetoric, proposing stricter border controls and deportation policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen and Ciotti push for stricter immigration controls, framing it as a national priority.
